No peer runtime data, credentials, branding or customer-specific logic were read or copied. Parity must be handled as a separate reviewed migration rather than creating a parallel unrequested outbound architecture.

Peer source was inspected read-only; adapting this behavior safely requires a separate mapping to its customer-specific campaign model without copying DG runtime data, credentials, branding or Pflege logic.

DG-MAIN: Texte behaupten nur noch eine Analyse ('Unsere Analyse von X zeigt'), wenn eine vorliegt; Video-Generierung ist ohne Analyse/Notizen gesperrt; Legacy-Kampagnen mit {{analysis_link}} schliessen Leads ohne Analyse aus. Vor Abschluss im Peer gleichwertig pruefen (Fallback-Saetze in Enrichment, Video-Route, LinkedIn-Entwuerfe, website-audit opener).

rules: Never replace the established Pflege UX with a new parallel dashboard to port a shared feature.
Adapt shared behavior into the existing Pflege surface.
Never create a second primary Pflege workspace; /pro must resolve back to the canonical root workspace.
Never lower the Pflege A+ qualification gate merely to fill the daily lead target; expose the deficit and keep searching instead.
Never copy customer data, credentials, Supabase refs, branding or industry-specific logic between instances.
Do not mark a shared-core task complete until both instances are adapted or a blocker is recorded here.
